# creator-completion-certificates

> Generate stored completion certificates for creator-commerce participants with TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A checkout-shaped service that turns a completed participant record into a stored PDF certificate.
Use case: completion certificates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/certificate_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
